adoption_boundaries.valid_state_rule: ib9b1–ib9b5 are all observed in {0,1} and sum to one

amendment_policy.after_any_outcome_by_adoption_result: no confirmatory amendment; additions are labelled exploratory and cannot replace frozen results
amendment_policy.before_any_e4_result: only a versioned amendment with reason, changed fields, new protocol hash and repeated QA
amendment_policy.max_activation: requires producer-code verification and a separate versioned amendment; cannot overwrite MOST results

association_inference.cross_boundary_covariance: equation-stacked observation-level HC3 influence functions on the identical establishments
association_inference.individual_ci: Bonferroni simultaneous 98.333333% two-sided confidence intervals across three beta estimates
association_inference.primary_covariance: HC3 on the transformed weighted design
source_dependence_sensitivities: CR1S-style source-cluster covariance with t(11) for individual coefficients
global source-cluster Wald result reported as a qualified sensitivity
leave-one-source-out coefficient ranges and sign stability
association_inference.survey_design_claim: None. No verified PSU, cluster or stratum identifier is available in the pooled file.

permitted: descriptive comparisons under the frozen sample and measurement contract
conditional associational comparisons across plausible MOST boundaries
out-of-sample predictive comparisons within observed source strata

control_coding.a5a: codes 1–11, 101 and 102 retained as categorical codes; any other or missing value set to UNKNOWN; no unsupported semantic relabelling
control_coding.a6: valid range 1800–2023; invalid/missing values replaced only for design coding by the source median; coded as decades from that median plus a separate missing/invalid indicator
control_coding.a7a: 0–4, 5–9, 10–19, 20–29, 30+; missing, negative or >80 set to UNKNOWN
control_coding.fixed_effect_reference_rule: first lexicographically sorted observed level; coefficient inference is invariant to the reference level
control_coding.ln_s7: natural log of positive s7, centred by the unweighted arithmetic mean within source and analytical sample
control_coding.missing_control_rule: explicit categorical unknowns or frozen indicator/median coding; controls may not change the common sample silently
control_coding.region_id: categorical only in source-by-region fixed effects; never relabelled as PSU or cluster
control_coding.s4: codes 0 and 1 retained as categories; all other or missing values set to UNKNOWN

terms: s4 multi-establishment factor with explicit unknown
a3b foreign-ownership category: domestic, any foreign, unknown
a6 establishment-age proxy centred in decades on the source median plus missing/invalid indicator

M2.prohibition: Do not include separate source and source-by-region fixed effects together.
terms: source-by-region fixed effects, which subsume source fixed effects

decision_rules.association_definition_sensitivity: H1_PRIMARY rejects and at least one gatekept pairwise contrast remains significant after Holm
decision_rules.decision_sensitivity_without_association: H1_PRIMARY does not reject but frozen prediction or classification comparison meets its own criterion
decision_rules.definition_robustness: no frozen association, prediction or classification comparison supports a material difference
decision_rules.novelty_guard: positive individual adoption–performance associations alone are insufficient because the producer article already documents technology–productivity associations
decision_rules.null_or_mixed_results: reported without reframing, outcome switching or selective robustness promotion

estimand.definition_sensitivity: Differences beta_integrated - beta_specialised, beta_specialised - beta_digital and beta_integrated - beta_digital on an identical outcome, sample, weight and control set.
estimand.primary: For each boundary d, beta_d is the source-weight-normalised WLS coefficient on A_d in the frozen M1 conditional-association model, interpreted in outcome log points within the observed source mixture.

heterogeneity.release_rule: no category-specific result where either adoption cell is below 20

sector_pooled.levels: a5a codes with design-only pooling of codes 2 and 11 as SPARSE_2_11
sector_pooled.pooling_basis: adoption cell feasibility only, before outcomes

size_band.reason_for_excluding_s7_lt_5: nominal population sensitivity and sparse integrated/specialised adoption cells

H1_PAIRWISE_GATEKEPT.gate: confirmatory interpretation only if H1_PRIMARY rejects at 0.05
H1_PAIRWISE_GATEKEPT.multiplicity: Holm familywise adjustment across three contrasts

H1_PRIMARY.alternative: at least one conditional association differs

H2_INDIVIDUAL_ASSOCIATIONS_SECONDARY.status: secondary and not a novelty claim by itself

H3_PREDICTION.question: Does adding a frozen adoption boundary improve establishment-level prediction within observed sources relative to the same M1 model without adoption?
H3_PREDICTION.stability_gate: better weighted RMSE than baseline in at least 16 of 20 repeated five-fold partitions

H4_OUTCOME_BASED_CLASSIFICATION.multiplicity: Holm across three pairwise BER differences
H4_OUTCOME_BASED_CLASSIFICATION.question: Do non-adopter screens defined by alternative boundaries have different balanced error rates for identifying the source-specific weighted bottom 20% of observed performance?
H4_OUTCOME_BASED_CLASSIFICATION.status: diagnostic, not policy effectiveness or optimal targeting

H5_HETEROGENEITY.follow_up: Holm-adjusted interaction contrasts within a moderator only if its BH gate opens
H5_HETEROGENEITY.multiplicity: Benjamini–Hochberg across three moderator tests at q=0.10
H5_HETEROGENEITY.test: one joint equation-stacked HC3 interaction test per moderator across all three boundaries

immutable_e2_elements.primary_weight: W_PRIMARY_SOURCE_MEAN1 = base_wt / unweighted mean(base_wt within source on the analytical sample)

multiplicity.heterogeneity: BH q=0.10 across three omnibus moderator tests; gated Holm follow-ups

outcome_based_classification.claim_restriction: diagnostic measurement consequence only; not policy effectiveness, treatment targeting or optimal allocation
outcome_based_classification.primary_metric: balanced error rate = 0.5 × (false-negative rate + false-positive rate), lower is better
outcome_based_classification.truth: Y_PRIMARY_RAW at or below the source-specific weighted 20th percentile
outcome_based_classification.uncertainty: source-stratified establishment bootstrap with source sizes fixed, thresholds and source-normalised weights recomputed in every replication
outcome_based_classification.weighted_quantile: smallest observed Y at which cumulative W_PRIMARY_SOURCE_MEAN1 reaches 20%; all threshold ties classified low performance

prediction_validation.model_comparison: M1 without adoption versus M1 plus each boundary; no tuning or feature selection
prediction_validation.primary: exact weighted leave-one-out PRESS using e_i/(1-h_i)
prediction_validation.scope: within observed source strata; not prediction for a new country or source

stability.conclusion_gate: at least 16 of 20 repetitions improve weighted RMSE versus baseline
stability.fold_assignment: outcome-blind deterministic shuffle within source × five-state MOST strata; identical partitions for all boundaries

release_and_disclosure.public_repository: data-free schema/synthetic mode only; no remote action authorised in E3

non_result_computational_incident.description: A design-matrix QA helper briefly solved weighted least-squares equations while returning only rank, condition-number and leverage diagnostics. No coefficient, standard error, p-value, outcome-by-boundary summary or residual was displayed, retained or used. All protocol choices had already been specified before the call. The final preflight was rerun with an X-only diagnostic routine.

robustness.principle: one axis at a time; no full factorial and no selective omission
robustness.promotion_rule: robustness results may not replace P0 because they are more favourable
